news.title: Consumer sentiment hits record low, inflation fears rise amid Iran war - CNBC
news.zh: 消費者信心跌至歷史新低，伊朗戰爭引發通膨擔憂加劇
news.impact: 消費信心崩潰恐拖累經濟成長，影響整體消費支出

news.title: Consumer prices rose 3.3% in March, as energy prices spiked due to Iran conflict - CNBC
news.zh: 3月消費者物價指數上漲3.3%，伊朗衝突致能源價格大幅攀升
news.impact: 通膨壓力持續，或影響聯準會貨幣政策決策

news.title: EV bloodbath: US sales plunge as Tesla tightens its grip - Business Insider
news.zh: 電動車市場遭冷遇，美國銷售額大幅下滑，特斯拉主宰地位加強
news.impact: 新能源產業增長放緩，競爭對手面臨生存壓力

news.title: US Postal Service to suspend employer pay to workers’ pensions, citing cash crunch - NewsNation
news.zh: 美國郵政局因資金困難，暫停雇主向員工退休基金撥款
news.impact: 公共機構財務惡化，員工退休保障風險上升

news.title: Kevin Warsh Fed chair confirmation plan hits snag as nomination hearing is delayed - CNBC
news.zh: 凱文·沃什聯準會主席提名遭延期，提名聽證會暫緩舉行
news.impact: 央行決策人事懸而未決，影響貨幣政策預期

news.title: Apple Will Close Its First Unionized Retail Location in the US - Bloomberg
news.zh: 蘋果公司將關閉其在美國首家已工會組織的零售店
news.impact: 零售工會運動受挫，勞資衝突面臨新轉折

news.title: Goldman Sachs resets its oil price forecasts for the rest of 2026 - thestreet.com
news.zh: 高盛重新評估並調整2026年全年石油價格預測
news.impact: 油價走勢預期變化，影響能源及通膨前景

news.title: xAI sues Colorado over first state AI anti-discrimination law - Financial Times
news.zh: xAI公司就科羅拉多州首部AI反歧視法對該州提起訴訟
news.impact: AI監管規範引發法律爭議，科技業面臨合規挑戰

news.title: North Sea oil prices hit record high as Iran keeps hold over Strait of Hormuz - Financial Times
news.zh: 北海石油價格攀升至歷史高位，伊朗掌控霍爾木茲海峽局勢
news.impact: 全球能源供應不確定性增加，油價上漲壓力持續

news.title: StubHub Refunding $10 Million in Fees to Consumers After Deceptive Ticket Pricing - Federal Trade Commission (.gov)
news.zh: StubHub因欺騙性票價定價向消費者退款1000萬美元 - 美國聯邦貿易委員會
news.impact: StubHub面臨監管處罰，消費者保護執法加強

news.title: ‘Tip of the inflation iceberg’: Social Security’s COLA forecast rises to 3.2%
news.zh: 「通膨冰山一角」：社會保障COLA預測上升至3.2%
news.impact: 社會安全福利成本上升，反映通膨壓力持續

news.title: Strait of Hormuz Constraints Keep Oil Prices Elevated
news.zh: 荷莫茲海峽限制措施使油價保持高位
news.impact: 地緣政治風險推升能源價格，影響全球經濟成本
